label: Commutator history
title: Commutator history and repeated perturbation do not yet isolate Class IV
summary: Older commutator values improve held-out prediction but retain the radius-two challenge. A separate four-arm experiment finds changed responsiveness in 224 ECA rules, so the weak memory and response criteria do not isolate Class IV.
takeaway: Predictive history is measurable, but its amount alone does not resolve the remaining class question or establish beam invariance.
